title: tooling: nothing stops a test's source from naming a PENDING changeset, and the only instrument that notices lives on the post-version tree
body:
Follow-up **C** from the director seat's ruling on #9472 (comment `5682619925`), which named it verbatim: *「**C**(a gate so pinning a pending changeset filename cannot return)is the follow-up: the dev files it from the same round.」* Filed, ⛔ not implemented — that ruling also said the repair (Q2-A) and this gate are two pieces of work, and the repair is #9582.

⛔ **No priority and no route beyond `domain:devx` set here** — the triage seat grades.

## The hazard, stated as a rule a gate could hold

**A test's source may not name a file that `.changeset/` currently carries.**

## Why it is a real class and not a one-off

`scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` resolves markdown path literals out of every test's source and offers only the ones that **exist in the tree**. So a test literal naming a pending changeset becomes a ledger entry — and `pnpm changeset:version` deletes exactly those files. On the post-version tree the scanner stops offering them, the entries turn into `stale-not-read` findings, and `Validate the post-version tree` goes red on the scheduled `Changeset Release` lane.

Measured instance, from #9472: two suites had done it, and the scheduled lane carried that assertion in every run of the window swept there.

| suite | literal | pending on `main` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `scripts/__tests__/check-changeset-overwrite.test.ts` | `.changeset/olive-donkeys-smile.md` | yes |
| `scripts/__tests__/check-installed-spec-pin-claims.test.ts` | `.changeset/8897-installed-spec-pin-claims.md` | yes |

## ⭐ Why no existing check can be the gate

The instrument that notices is the `markdown-test-inputs` audit, and it notices **only on a post-version tree** — a tree that exists nowhere except inside the scheduled release job, which no reader of a pull request sees. Every ordinary check is green while the literal is being written, because the file it names is sitting right there. The signal arrives days later, in a lane whose failure blocks the version pull request's refresh rather than anything on the author's page.

⇒ the gate has to answer the question **on the pre-version tree**, from the two things it can both see: the set of test-source literals under `.changeset/`, and the contents of `.changeset/`. Their intersection must be empty. That is a cheap, total predicate — it needs no version step and no simulation.

## Still open after #9582

That pull request repaired the two suites above by name. It left two fixture literals in `check-changeset-overwrite.test.ts` — `.changeset/plum-pandas-wave.md` and `.changeset/6336-new-work.md` — which are **not** pending today and so are not that defect, but which would become it the day a changeset lands under either name. Repairing filenames one at a time is what this card exists to stop.

## Dedup search words

`pending changeset filename` · `stale-not-read` · `markdown-test-inputs ledger` · `post-version tree validate` · `changeset version consumes`
